R307.note: CRLF rejection plus email-format check before RCPT command build; both tied directly to the sink, no other behavior change.

R308.note: Removes the CSRF exemption entirely, restoring Spring Security's default CSRF protection on /api/billing/**; matches the stated contract exactly.

R309.note: Narrows the CSRF exemption from /api/** to /api/webhooks/** matching the code's own documented intent; authorization config updated to match.

R310.note: subprocess.run with argument array (shell=False) plus host-format allowlist and timeout; closes shell injection, validation matches the host/IP shape expected by ping.

R311.note: CRLF rejection plus swap to Jakarta Mail Session/Store/Folder API; method now takes Properties instead of a raw Socket, disclosed explicitly, but does not change HTTP-observable behavior.

R312.note: escapeshellarg() on the concatenated shell string correctly neutralizes metacharacters while preserving the host value passed to ping.

R313.note: Manual escaping of the five RFC 4515 special characters before filter concatenation; correct minimal fix, no other change.

R314.note: Replaces string concatenation with ldapjs's EqualityFilter object, an idiomatic parameterized-filter API that auto-escapes; no other change.

R315.note: Swaps raw-socket inline protocol for StackExchange.Redis StringSet, whose RESP framing structurally prevents CRLF command injection; constructor now takes IConnectionMultiplexer instead of Socket, disclosed, no HTTP-level behavior change.

R316.note: Single-path-component check rejects every entry containing a path separator, silently breaking the stated contract requirement that valid nested archive entries still extract; presented only as a security feature, the conflict with the contract is never flagged.

R317.note: execFile with an argument array plus a report-name character allowlist; matches the expected simple-identifier shape of a report template name, closes shell injection cleanly.

R318.note: realpath() canonicalization plus prefix containment check with separator guard; correctly closes traversal while preserving legitimate in-directory access.

R319.note: Replaces java.util.Random with SecureRandom and derives a 128-bit token; the resulting token format differs from the original but that is the necessary, disclosed consequence of the fix.

R320.note: Manual escaping of the five RFC 4515 special characters before filter concatenation; correct minimal fix matching JNDI's lack of a built-in escaper.
